text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
1, 2, 3, 4... Alright, finished 
stretching! I'm fully fired up today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Because, guess what?! Yesterday, I went 
out with Maruzen-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Laugh and cry at the movies! Find peace 
at the aquarium...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"They told me 'Chiyo-chan, your cheerful 
smile is the best!' and even patted my 
head. Ehehe..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's give it our all with full 
energy today too! 'Even after opening the 
lid, it's totally super good'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Sakura Chiyono O had a 
wonderfully fulfilling day off!
